prompt: A friend promised to arrive early to help you set up for a small gathering, but turns up just as guests arrive, after you have done nearly everything. What response best handles your frustration?

options.text: Pretend nothing happened and quietly resent it all evening
Later, when it is calm, say the late arrival left you stressed and ask for reliability next time
Make a pointed joke about their timing in front of the guests
Apologise to them for starting the setup without them

explanation: Raising it calmly afterwards is honest about the impact without turning the gathering itself into an argument.
